verdict.rationale: Nix is inherently self-hostable open-source software: it is installed locally via a shell script (nix-docs-11/23/32), builds entirely from source or local/self-hosted binary caches (nix-docs-36/52), and NixOS itself can be deployed on owned hardware, EC2, or custom ISOs (nix-docs-15/21/40/51, nix-comm-5). There is no vendor lock-in or SaaS dependency, and the core package manager and OS run fully under user control. missing for 10: no explicit first-party guide titled 'self-hosting' or documentation of self-hosting a private binary cache/Hydra CI server, and no independent hands-on report specifically confirming a fully self-hosted deployment.
